Summary of today's Mutual Fund Market

As of the close on July 11th, 2023: Nifty 50 opened at 19422.8, closed down 0.85% at 19331.8. Sensex50 started at 20361.86, end at 20325.86, stood the same with the previous close price.

Given the performance of the stock market, the equity funds market performed weakly. There were 23 funds that rose today, took 40.48% of the equity fund market, and 11 of which increased by more than 1%. Concurrently, 33 or 59.52% of funds fell, with 19 decreased by more than 1%.

Compare to equity fund market, debt funds performed weakly, with 11 funds rising today and 25 funds falling.
